artists.biography: Snarky Puppy is a Grammy-winning instrumental fusion band from Denton, Texas led by bassist, composer and producer Michael League. Formed in Denton, Texas in 2004, the band features a collective of nearly 30 musicians, referred to as "The Fam" on their recordings and tours. The musicians perform on a variety of instruments including guitars, keyboards, saxophones, brass, percussion and strings. Many of the current and former band members were once students at the University of North Texas.  The band released their debut album "Live at Uncommon Ground" in 2005 and began touring extensively after their second album "The Only Constant" in 2006. Snarky Puppy's first four albums were released under Sitmom Records. Their fifth album, "Tell Your Friends" was released in 2010 under Ropeadope Records.  In 2013, Snarky Puppy embarked on their biggest project yet with the "Family Dinner Volume One." They teamed up with some of their favorite vocalists in the world for a live recording at the Jefferson Center in Roanoke, Virginia. Their Performance of the song "Something" with Lalah Hathaway has earned them a 2014 Grammy for Best R&B Performance.  Snarky Puppy's leader, Michael League, was interviewed and written about in the 2010 book release "The New Face of Jazz: An intimate look at today's living legends and the artists of tomorrow" by Cicily Janus. The author cites League's self-termed music as "jafunkadansion" for its genre-bending qualities of instrumental and dance music. Cicily Janus also comments the "group Snarky Puppy is one of the most inventive in sound and funk since Maynard Ferguson's fusion years."  Band Members: bernard wright - keyboards robert "sput" searight - keyboards & drums shaun martin - keyboards bill laurance - keyboards and piano bobby sparks - keyboards and organ chris mcqueen - guitar bob lanzetti - guitar michael league - bass steve pruitt - drums nate werth - percussion justin stanton - trumpet and keyboards mike maher - trumpet jay jennings - trumpet brian donohoe - soprano & alto saxophones chris bullock - tenor saxophone clay pritchard - tenor saxophone zach brock - violin

perplexity.description:
We Like It Here (Remixed + Remastered + Reimagined), released in 2024 on GroundUP Music, is a refreshed edition of Snarky Puppy's landmark 2014 live-in-studio album that blends jazz with funk and world music influences. The album showcases the collective’s virtuosic musicianship and dynamic interplay, capturing the energy of a live performance with studio-level sonic clarity. It features intricate grooves, layered rhythms, and memorable melodies, exemplified by standout tracks like “Lingus,” which combines a slow horn melody, funky bass, and an extended, electrifying solo section. This edition offers a new perspective on the original material through remixing and remastering, enhancing the textures and details of the ensemble’s sound.

In Snarky Puppy’s discography, We Like It Here is often regarded as a breakthrough work that helped redefine contemporary jazz fusion by making it more accessible and vibrant. The album’s communal spirit and fusion of styles have contributed to the band’s reputation for revitalizing jazz and funk for modern audiences. Critics have praised the album for its balance of complexity and groove, with some noting its appeal as both engaging background music and a showcase of sophisticated musicianship. While the original release was critically acclaimed and helped elevate Snarky Puppy’s profile, this 2024 reissue has been welcomed for bringing renewed attention to the band’s innovative approach and the timeless quality of the performances.
